question:
Select the correct spelling from the given options to fill in the blank.

I hope you will excuse me for doing what is only my duty, although it may appear _______.
solution:
The correct answer is: **impertinent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"impertinent"** means not showing proper respect; rude. (असभ्य)

 
 
• **Example: **The student's impertinent remarks to the teacher were not appreciated.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that the person hopes that someone will forgive him/her for performing what is merely his/her duty, even if it might seem disrespectful.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.
